register_model: register a new model class with a unique key name in the fairchem registry
register_task: register a new task class with a unique key name in the fairchem registry
register_dataset: register a new dataset class with a unique key name in the fairchem registry
get_class: get a registered class by name from a specific mapping like model or task
register_unregister: register a value under a dotted key path and later unregister it from the registry state
